commit_subject: pets: add 'Hatch all ready eggs' — spam-adopting leaves several eggs that each had to be selected and hatched one card at a time, which feels stuck. New button on the My Pets card hatches EVERY ready egg: the value-free hatch auto-signs (a quick wallet bounce), the redirect serialises each, and on return maybeAutoHatch() fires the next until none remain (flag in localStorage survives the round-trips; self-heals via the 180s inflight expiry). Button shows the ready count and a live 'Hatching all… (N left)'. (Diagnosed the report on the live chain: the user's two eggs ARE hatchable — gene blocks exist, node serves the hashes, well under the 18000-block STALE limit — so the block was purely the one-at-a-time UX / stale client view.)

slots + roulette: (1) SPIN is now LOCKED for the whole spin, not just the submit — the button re-enabled the instant the seat hit the chain even though the reels were still resolving, so you could fire a second spin over a spinning reel; now disabled from lever-pull through the entire pending window until the result lands. (2) MAX-BET slider added to roulette (stake <= free_bankroll/(M-1)) and slots (bank's 150x-coverable max), matching dice — a 'Max' shortcut + a slider bounded by the table's live free cover, so you can't stake past what the house can pay

slots + dice UX: (1) SLOTS rapid-spin animation no longer freezes — the reels were driven by mineSpins[0] sorted by RANDOM seat id, so an old resolved spin could hijack the display, and nothing showed spinning during the submit→land window; now ordered by local submit time and the reels spin from the instant the lever is pulled (dapp.busy) through the pending window. (2) DICE gets a MAX-BET slider: the biggest stake the table can cover at the current win-chance (stake <= free_bankroll*target/(EDGE-target)) with a 'Max' shortcut, kept in step with the table's live free cover — no more trial-and-error into the 'can't cover' error
